reviews.title: Legacy Use Lost
reviews.text: I have been a loyal user of this app since its first version, and have it on both iPhone and iPad. My iPhone version has retained access to most of the original courses, even if they were not downloaded, while the iPad (even after clicking “restore purchases”) affirms that I have no access to any “premium content.” I am really disappointed—I have paid many years for subscription and would really like the core content that I have had always to STAY available in future updates and subscription models. Does loyalty count for nothing these days?
